006package dev.metaschema.core.model.constraint;
007
008import java.util.List;
009import java.util.Locale;
010import java.util.function.Supplier;
011
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.IMetapathExpression;
013import dev.metaschema.core.model.IAssemblyDefinition;
014import dev.metaschema.core.model.IDefinition;
015import dev.metaschema.core.model.IFieldDefinition;
016import dev.metaschema.core.model.IFlagDefinition;
017import dev.metaschema.core.model.ISource;
018import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
019import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
020
021/**
022 * Provides an base implementation for a set of constraints that target a
023 * definition using a target Metapath expression.
024 *
025 * @param <T>
026 *          the Java type of the constraint container
027 */
028public abstract class AbstractTargetedConstraints<T extends IValueConstrained>
029    implements ITargetedConstraints, IFeatureValueConstrained {
030  @NonNull
031  private final ISource source;
032  @NonNull
033  private final Supplier<List<IMetapathExpression>> targets;
034  @NonNull
035  private final T constraints;
036
037  /**
038   * Construct a new set of targeted constraints.
039   *
040   * @param source
041   *          information about the resource the constraints were sources from
042   * @param targets
043   *          a supplier to get the Metapath expressions that can be used to find
044   *          matching targets
045   * @param constraints
046   *          the constraints to apply to matching targets
047   */
048  protected AbstractTargetedConstraints(
049      @NonNull ISource source,
050      @NonNull Supplier<List<IMetapathExpression>> targets,
051      @NonNull T constraints) {
052    this.source = source;
053    this.targets = targets;
054    this.constraints = constraints;
055  }
056
057  @Override
058  public ISource getSource() {
059    return source;
060  }
061
062  @Override
063  public List<IMetapathExpression> getTargets() {
064    return ObjectUtils.notNull(targets.get());
065  }
066
067  @Override
068  public T getConstraintSupport() {
069    return constraints;
070  }
071
072  /**
073   * Apply the constraints to the provided {@code definition}.
074   * <p>
075   * This will be called when a definition is found that matches the target
076   * expression.
077   *
078   * @param definition
079   *          the definition to apply the constraints to.
080   */
081  protected void applyTo(@NonNull IValueConstrained definition) {
082    getLetExpressions().values().forEach(definition::addLetExpression);
083    getAllowedValuesConstraints().forEach(definition::addConstraint);
084    getMatchesConstraints().forEach(definition::addConstraint);
085    getIndexHasKeyConstraints().forEach(definition::addConstraint);
086    getExpectConstraints().forEach(definition::addConstraint);
087    getReportConstraints().forEach(definition::addConstraint);
088  }
089
090  @Override
091  public void target(IFlagDefinition definition) {
092    applyTo(definition);
093  }
094
095  @Override
096  public void target(IFieldDefinition definition) {
097    applyTo(definition);
098  }
099
100  @Override
101  public void target(IAssemblyDefinition definition) {
102    applyTo(definition);
103  }
104
105  /**
106   * Throws a {@link ConstraintInitializationException} indicating that the
107   * constraint target is not valid.
108   *
109   * @param definition
110   *          the targeted definition
111   * @throws ConstraintInitializationException
112   *           when method is called to indicate that the provided definition is
113   *           not a valid constraint target
114   */
115  protected void wrongDefinitionTypeTargeted(@NonNull IDefinition definition) {
116    throw new ConstraintInitializationException(
117        String.format(
118            "The %s named '%s' from metaschema '%s' is incorrectly targeted by a set of" +
119                " constraints with the target(s) '%s'. Ensure the target expression is correct in '%s'.",
120            definition.getModelType().name().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT),
121            definition.getEffectiveName(),
122            definition.getContainingModule().getQName().toString(),
123            getTargets(),
124            getSource().getLocationHint()));
125  }
126}
